title: Todays World
excerpt: While we think about our future, we end up in a saturated pool of like-minded people!
body:
The world is full of opportunities, but with AI we have reached a point of saturation where everyone is creating products and the market has become very saturated! And that is why we feel like we should bring change and make ours and others life better for the future.

Everyone wants to be the next Bill Gates and Elon Musk, but have we thought about being the next us? We always see other peoples' success but we don't work towards our own.

"Walking on your path imperfectly is better than mimicking others' path perfectly."
- Gita 3.35

This has been said before but it will only make sense when you actually work towards your own identity and realize what you are creating!

Whenever you feel like giving up, then think about other peoples' path, did they reach where they are by giving up? That is why you should learn from their actions and then walk your own path!

title: Engineering 101
excerpt: When I first thought of pursuing engineering as my career...
body:
What is engineering? An easy major pick or a major life decision?

It is the gap between understanding life just enough that if you pursue it more then nothing would make sense anymore... Just how this sentence didn't make sense!

The main reason to pick engineering is not because everyone wants you to become one, it is because you want to understand life better and fix problems in this world full of problems!

The reality you may ask? You pick engineering because one day you want to build what Tony Stark built in a cave with a box of scraps... its not that its impossible to do that, but the main problem is that you already have to be smart enough to figure things out because in a classroom there is just enough to learn. You are not gonna get time from assignments and exams and all day running from one class to the other.
